change: A public LoadLimits contract now bounds bytes per file, logical records, shards or clusters, aggregate payload bytes, regenerated projector bytes and compression expansion.
FRAC, RECS, SKCH, OSMS, CLST, OSHH and hybrid generation loaders open files, inspect metadata and retain at most max+1 bytes before parsing or allocation.
Manifest counts, decompressed payloads, component hashes, centroid arrays and sketch projectors are validated against checked sizes and caller-selected budgets before allocation.
Compatibility methods retain finite defaults while explicit with_limits variants allow reviewed tighter or larger budgets.
